content_of_post_to_comment: The decisions the writers chose to make for the adaptation of Netflix’s Avatar: The Last Airbender literally make me physically unwell. I don’t understand how so many people could misunderstand a text so fundamentally. Maybe this is why Catholics and Protestants are so much meaner to each other than they are to atheists, maybe interpreting a scripture incorrectly is worse than never reading it at all.
comment: There’s an interesting difference between changing a story and misreading it: adaptations inevitably reinterpret, but the real fracture happens when the values driving the original are no longer visible in the new choices.
